To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) multimodal attention is effective for image captioning, (2) the attention mechanism can be trained end-to-end with the NMT model, (3) the attention mechanism is effective in a multilingual setting.
a dedicated attention mechanism for each modality is beneficial to the performance of a multimodal NMT model.

1) the multimodal attention outperforms a purely textual NMT baseline; 2) a dedicated attention for both modalities achieves better results than a shared attention; 3) the attention over the source language description is more important than the attention over the image.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how a model can learn to focus over multiple modalities and what is the best way to combine them in order to generate a description in another natural language.
multimodal attention for image captioning.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multimodal attention mechanism improves the performance of the NMT model.
our proposed multimodal attention mechanism can effectively leverage the image information for generating a description of the image in a different language.
multimodal attention is an important component of the neural image captioning and it improves the performance in terms of BLEU and METERO scores.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
multimodal attention mechanism is an effective way to leverage both the image and its description for machine translation.
multimodal attention is an effective approach for multilingual image caption generation.
the multimodal attention mechanism is an effective way to incorporate image information into NMT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the attention mechanism is a promising way for incorporating the image modality in the NMT framework.
the multimodal attention is an effective approach to combine the information from the two modalities, but it does not outperform the textual NMT baseline in the image-to-text translation task.
a multimodal attention can be successfully trained for image captioning, which is a step towards multimodal NMT.
